title: Add recompute flow for derived state

context.summary: Allow derived document state to be recalculated by document or stage without mutating RAW originals.
context.background: TASK-38 introduced processing_runs and artifact tables. TASK-39 introduced document.route. The next step is an explicit recompute entrypoint that creates a new processing run, supersedes old derived runs and re-enters the processing graph.

in: Add document.recompute job type and migration.
Add core recompute request service and stage validation.
Add API endpoints to request recompute and list document processing runs.
Add DB repository methods to list and supersede document processing runs.
Add worker recompute processor that records checksum/source storage key and re-enqueues routing.
Keep RAW original storage key unchanged and record raw_original_unchanged metadata.
Update integration tests, validators and documentation.
out: Implement modality-specific artifact regeneration beyond the existing route/text pipeline.
Expose CLI, MCP or Hermes recompute commands.
Wait for all downstream route/extract/chunk/embed/index jobs before marking the recompute run succeeded.

acceptance_criteria: document.recompute exists in core queue types, Drizzle schema and a forward migration without changing 0000_initial_schema.
POST /v1/documents/:id/recompute creates a durable recompute job.
GET /v1/documents/:id/processing-runs lists processing runs for the document.
The worker creates or reuses a deterministic processing_run for the recompute request.
Older matching processing runs are marked superseded and reference the new run id.
The recompute processor preserves source_document_storage_key and records source_document_checksum.
The recompute processor enqueues document.route with processing_run_id metadata.
Integration tests prove repeated recompute supersedes the older run while the RAW storage key remains unchanged.

manual_checks: Confirm recompute reads but does not write or replace RAW original objects.

risks: The current recompute run represents scheduling/replanning, not completion of all downstream modality jobs.
Future artifact writers must use processing_run_id consistently so superseded runs are ignored by search APIs.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
